Official pdf.js distribution vendored from GitHub release `v5.5.207`.

Source release asset:
`https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/releases/download/v5.5.207/pdfjs-5.5.207-dist.zip`

Included runtime subset:
- `build/pdf.mjs`
- `build/pdf.worker.mjs`
- `web/cmaps/`
- `web/standard_fonts/`
- `web/wasm/`
- `web/iccs/`
